mapper.sql: emp11_reward_id AS reward_id, emp11_person_id AS person_id, emp11_reward_cd AS reward_cd, f_cdnm('EmpRewardCode', emp11_reward_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS reward_cd_nm, TO_CHAR(emp11_reward_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reward_dt, emp11_reward_group AS reward_group, emp11_reward_nm AS reward_nm, emp11_reward_desc AS reward_desc, emp11_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp11_reward JOIN emp01_person ON emp11_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp11_reward_id = #{rewardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp11_reward ( emp11_reward_id, emp11_person_id, emp11_reward_cd, emp11_reward_dt , emp11_reward_group, emp11_reward_nm, emp11_reward_desc, emp11_note ) VALUES ( #{rewardId}, #{req.personId}, #{req.rewardCd} , #{req.rewardDt}::date , #{req.rewardGroup}, #{req.rewardNm}, #{req.rewardDesc}, #{req.note} )
